entities.summary: Georg Anton Lorenz Diefenbach was a German philologist and lexicographer, as well as a novelist associated with the German nationalist movement. By career he was a pastor, like his father, and a librarian. Lorenz Diefenbach was a physicians & medical pioneers from Germany (1806-07-29, Germany–1883-03-28). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
